items.title: Carolyn Buck Interview, 1969-03-25
items.q: Carol, he said, Carol, I don't want to leave you. He said, but child, he says, I'll come back. I'll come back after you.

ctx.x: What was the afternoon before he died?

The afternoon. I came home. I hadn't been home for three or four days. I came home to take a shower because I had never left the hospital. I wouldn't come home for three or four hours and take a shower fresh enough and go back. And that afternoon, um, he couldn't talk. I let him know I was coming home to take a shower. And I sensed something was happening. The nurse had said he was doing fine. The doctor had tried to reassure me he was doing fine. And, uh, I came home and the first thing I asked Shirley, I said,…
